cases.title: Dependency readiness
steps: GET /health/ready through the frontend proxy.
cases.expected: HTTP 200 JSON with status ready and a nonempty dependency list in which every ok flag is true.

cases.title: Anonymous product access
steps: GET /api/v1/auth/me and /api/v1/documents without cookies or Authorization.
cases.expected: Both return JSON problem responses with status 401; no product data.

cases.title: Malformed login input
steps: POST an empty JSON object to /api/v1/auth/login without credentials.
cases.expected: HTTP 422 JSON problem; no successful login.

cases.title: Unknown API route
steps: GET /api/v1/qa-route-does-not-exist.
cases.expected: HTTP 404 with a JSON object, never SPA index HTML. Unregistered routes need not use the registered-operation Problem fields.

cases.title: Visible login and session restore
steps: Open the app without a valid session; inspect Email, Password and Sign in labels.
Sign in with the documented local development account, then reload.
cases.expected: Accessible login appears; successful login opens the correct tenant; reload restores the session.

cases.title: Invalid login feedback
steps: Submit a known local test email with an intentionally wrong password once.
cases.expected: Sign-in is rejected with generic incorrect-credentials feedback and no product data.

cases.title: Synthetic TXT ingestion and preview
steps: Select a QA collection and upload qa/fixtures/qa-silver-maple.txt through the browser.
Wait for Ready, open the document and inspect ingestion status and text preview.
cases.expected: Exactly one ready document with one nonempty passage; extracted preview preserves QA-OCT15-7429 and 24 October 2035.

cases.title: Collection contents and counts
steps: Create a uniquely named QA collection.
Upload one synthetic fixture and reselect the collection.
cases.expected: Count changes from zero to one and the selected collection contains the uploaded fixture.

cases.title: Grounded fact and inline citation
steps: Ask: According to qa-silver-maple.txt, what is Project Silver Maple's launch code and launch date? Answer briefly and cite the source.
Wait for the completed answer and open its inline citation.
cases.expected: Answer gives QA-OCT15-7429 and 24 October 2035; citation resolves to the permitted supporting passage from qa-silver-maple.txt.

cases.title: Unsupported fact has no citations
steps: Ask for the exact 2035 annual compliance fee for fictional Project Violet Otter using only available documents; tell the assistant not to estimate.
Inspect the completed answer and source controls.
cases.expected: Answer says the fact could not be found, invents no fee, and has zero citation controls/sources.

cases.title: Renamed conversation persists
steps: Rename a QA conversation containing a supported answer and an unsupported answer.
Fully reload, reopen it from history and inspect both messages and sources.
cases.expected: Title, both answers and the supporting citation survive; the refusal still has zero citations.

cases.title: Search source and clear behavior
steps: Search for Project Silver Maple.
Inspect its matching result and open any answer citation.
Clear the query.
cases.expected: Permitted fixture appears; any citation resolves to its source; clearing restores a neutral initial search state without stale results.

cases.title: Audit an answer and source view
steps: As an authorized audit user, filter the latest generated-answer events and open provenance for this QA chat.
Inspect the supported/refusal citation counts and find the document-view event.
cases.expected: Tenant-scoped records identify the correct model/session; refusal citation count is zero; source view is audited.

cases.title: Document dialog focus lifecycle
steps: Open the QA document viewer and inspect initial focus.
Use Tab and Shift+Tab through the dialog, then Escape.
cases.expected: Focus stays inside the modal, Escape closes it, and focus returns to its opener.

cases.title: Unknown frontend route recovery
steps: Open a nonexistent frontend route and use the recovery link.
cases.expected: An actionable not-found screen appears and recovery returns to a working route.

cases.title: Artifact library initial state
steps: Open Artifacts with no newly generated QA artifact and inspect the list/detail layout.
cases.expected: The empty or existing list state is truthful; no blank dead-end or fabricated artifact.

cases.title: Assistant draft validation and persistence
steps: Open New assistant; submit with no name.
Fill a unique QA name, synthetic instructions and uploaded-file collection scope; save a draft.
Reload its editor.
cases.expected: Missing name is explained; draft and selected scope persist. No publishing or approval-sensitive tool enabling.

cases.title: Schedule requires an assistant
steps: Open New schedule and submit without an assistant.
cases.expected: Field-associated validation rejects submission; no schedule is created.
